name: G6 T3 W04 - Finish and check spreadsheets
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: Information arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The table puts each club name beside its student count.

words.definition: A picture that presents data so people can compare or understand it.
words.example: The chart uses bars to compare the club counts.

words.definition: A name or short piece of text that identifies something.
words.example: The label under each bar names the club.

words.definition: The information stored in a cell or variable.
A check of how two things are similar or different.
words.example: Our comparison shows that chess has more students than art.
